behaviorRules: On selection timeout, V1 fills remaining selections from captured order, chooses first frame only if current frame id is empty, then calls startPrinting(userConfirmed=false).

SELECTING_PHOTOS and EDITING keep remainingPhotoTime/remainingFrameTime across state changes/back navigation until explicitly cleared; ordinary interaction calls resetInactivityTimer, clears only the current state's retained budget, and restarts that state's full configured timer.

PRINT_PENDING starts a timer only when inactivityJob is null. If the EDITING frame timer job survives into PRINT_PENDING, its existing frame budget remains authoritative; postCaptureTimeoutSeconds is only a fallback when a fresh non-selection timer is started. Do not assert that it delays capture or always governs PRINT_PENDING.
The timeout path is auto-print, not merely auto-advance; revenue is separately gated by userConfirmed and accepted print job.
SettingsManager preserves blank/comment/unrelated lines, replaces matching keys, appends absent keys, and adds a final newline.
Loader precedence is working .env, then app-data .env, then process environment (later maps win); save target is config.envSource or working .env.
Malformed timeout values fall back to defaults but valid negative/over-3600 values are not clamped by the loader. The stepper itself constrains UI-generated values to 0..3600.
V1 says restart after save. Some activeConfig consumers change immediately, but camera source/service does not; parity testing must distinguish stored, activeConfig-applied, and hardware-applied.
